children: , Switzerland's upper house of parliament on Wednesday voted in favour of capital rules that would require the bank to back its foreign units with 90% Common Equity Tier 1 capital.

Following the decision in the first of two chambers, the capital rules bill will move to the lower house of parliament, with a final decision expected at the end of this year at the earliest, and more likely in 2027.

title: Swiss upper house backs 90% CET1 capital backing for UBS foreign units
